summary: John's 5th great-uncle; brother of Agatha Heizler; gravedigger at Servatius's burial.
bio: 'Fridrich Heitzler, geb. 8ten März 1809, lediger Taglöhner, 26 Jahre alt, ehelicher Sohn des + Josef Heizler, gewesenen herrschaftlichen Jägers, und der Anna Federer' married Francisca Widlebacher (b. 28 Sep 1811) on 7 Oct 1835 at Munzingen. In 1853, as Todtengräber, he witnessed his brother-in-law Servatius's burial.
